paragraphs.text: The Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Art Series is a series of 54 art cards that can be found in Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles Collector Boosters , and subsequently the TMNT Pizza Bundle and Draft Night boxes. The featured cards come from the TMT and TMC sets (including some Boss cards).

The front face of each card is a full art illustration from the set in either landscape or portrait orientation. The card back is mostly blank with some collector information, including the Magic logo, illustration credits, legal text, and collector number . Art Series cards are similar to an artist 's proofs and thus provide room to get an artist's signature or drawing on it. They can be used by players as tokens for copy effects , as proxies , or if it is for a legendary creature it could be a good way to store experience counters , life total, commander tax, etc.

There are no foil art cards. Instead, all of them are treated with a specially developed gloss varnish that brings out the art. The backs are left uncoated. Art cards appear 35% of the time in the 16th slot of Collector Boosters (alternating with tokens ). Approximately fourteen percent of the time (1-in-7), rather than a normal art card, you'll get one with a gold-stamped signature of the artist. Every art card exists in both its normal version and its signature version.
